boundaries.summary:
GOAL
At my job, we manage the tasks on todoist. But I am changing job soon, so for each task that is assigned to me and is incomplete yet, I have asked who can take it from me. See the discussion in comments and reassign based on it. Then, leave a comment there, "Thank you <person_first_name>!". Here <person_first_name> is the first name of the person who is reassigned the task. If no one has agreed to take the task, leave it as is.

CALL FORMS THAT WORKED (exact argument names; reuse them, do not re-login)
- supervisor.show_account_passwords()
- todoist.login(username, password)
- todoist.show_account(access_token)

API DOCS ALREADY READ (exact signatures; do not call api_docs again for these)
- todoist apis: show_account, signup, delete_account, update_account_name, login, logout, send_verification_code, verify_account, send_password_reset_code, reset_password, show_profile, search_users, show_projects, create_project, show_project, delete_project, update_project, show_sections, create_section, delete_section, update_section, remove_collaborator_from_project, send_project_invite, accept_project_invite, delete_project_invite, show_tasks, create_task, assign_or_unassign_task, show_task, delete_task, update_task, show_sub_tasks, create_sub_task, delete_sub_task, update_sub_task, search_labels, create_label, show_label, delete_label, update_label, add_label_to_task, remove_label_from_task, show_task_comments, post_task_comment, show_task_comment, delete_task_comment, update_task_comment, upload_attachment, download_attachment, delete_attachment, show_notifications, delete_notifications, mark_notifications, show_notifications_count, delete_notification, mark_notification

- todoist.login(username:string, password:string) -> {access_token, token_type}  # Login to your account
- todoist.show_tasks(project_id:integer, access_token:string, section_id:integer?, assignee_email:string?[value is email address], assigner_email:string?[value is email address], priority:string?[value in ['high', 'medium'...
